case_title: Sebil Elanjimpally v. The State of Odisha
neutral_facts: The appellant was charged with alleged commission of offences under Section 20(b)(ii)(C) of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985. The appellant had been in custody for two years and 11 months. The High Court rejected the appellant's bail application, citing that the co-accused, who had been released on bail, had not surrendered. The Court also noted the appellant's father had undergone surgery and directed expeditious disposal of the case. The High Court was requested to reconsider the matter, given that the charges had been framed and 19 prosecution witnesses were proposed to be examined by the State.
